name: Brar Roofing Solution
description: Storm damage, leaks and slipped tiles fixed fast by Brar Roofing Solution Pty Ltd (ABN 65 658 972 868). Services include roof leak repairs, pressure washing and roof painting, repointing, rusted valley replacement, metal roof replacement, polycarbonate installs and terracotta tile cleaning, using quality materials at competitive prices.
shortDescription: Roof leaks, repairs and repointing — workmanship guaranteed.

name: Ayhairr
description: Ayhairr offers haircuts, blow-dries, hair colour, foils, balayage, keratin and Japanese straightening, plus facial treatments, threading and waxing. Hair colour transformations are performed using Fanola, a leading professional colour brand.
shortDescription: Hair colour, styling and beauty treatments with Fanola colour.

name: Educally
description: Now enrolling for Term 2 2026 — Educally provides tutoring from Kindy to Year 12 in Maths, English and Science, plus senior Maths (Standard, Advanced, Extension) and Business Studies. Small, focused groups offer individual learning plans and concept-based teaching, with specialised Selective, OC and NAPLAN preparation and assessment through an online learning platform. Free assessment available.

name: Allan's TV Wall Mounting
description: Professional TV wall mounting with 10 years' experience, backed by 5-star Google reviews and a finalist placing in The Hills Local Business Awards 2025/26. Allan stocks the largest range of brackets and cables, with a 12-month guarantee on installation and a 60-month warranty on brackets and cables.
shortDescription: Trusted local TV wall mounting, 10 years' experience.

name: Windsor Marsden Park Richmond Taxi
description: Reliable, punctual taxi services for airport, cruise and suburban transfers at competitive prices (ABN 13 517 529 263, BSP 410847). Point to Point Transport Commissioner authorised, fully licensed and insured, with GPS tracking, surveillance and child seats available on request across sedans, SUVs, wagons, 7 and 11 seaters, and luxury taxis and limos. 15% off for West and North Western Sydney suburb residents.
shortDescription: Licensed airport, cruise and suburban taxi transfers.

name: Just Cut Grass
description: Just Cut Grass is a local lawn mowing and garden maintenance service offering lawn mowing, edging, whipper snipping, hedge trimming, general yard tidy-ups and weed spraying. Reliable, affordable and professional — first-time customers receive $10 off their first service.
shortDescription: Lawn mowing and garden maintenance — $10 off first service.

name: Smart Brain Electrical Service
description: Smart Brain Electrical Service (Electrical Licence No. 381554C) installs EV chargers for Tesla, BYD, Zappi, BMW and all other models, with installation prices starting at $550.
shortDescription: EV charger installation for all makes, from $550.

name: Arshdeep Landscaping
description: Arshdeep Landscaping delivers fencing, turf and artificial grass installation, garden beds, mulch, tree and paver work, and retaining walls in timber or rendered block for a range of landscaping and outdoor projects.
shortDescription: Fencing, turf, artificial grass and retaining walls.

name: The Trendz
description: The Trendz Schofields Showroom presents the 2026 Modern Furniture Collection, featuring indoor and outdoor furniture, dining and coffee tables, and decor, with a focus on premium quality and design.
shortDescription: Modern indoor & outdoor furniture, Schofields Showroom.

name: FitBeatz Dance Fitness
description: FitBeatz is a dance fitness class filled with great music, easy moves and feel-good vibes, held at Applause Performing Arts from 9:00am to 9:45am, starting 3rd May. Join the WhatsApp group or register via the Zumba booking link to reserve a spot.
shortDescription: Dance fitness class at Applause Performing Arts.
